title: Default record page: no derived highlight strip (declared highlightFields only); the stage field leaves the body when the path draws it; the owner appears once, under one word
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

Filed by the record-page epic seat, part of epic #26676. The seat walked the console on `main` `c064d3a246`, with `examples/app-crm` as the backend, at 1440 / 1100 / 375 px, light and dark. An independent review pass then checked each finding against the code. The maintainer ruled on the reviewed list and said 「按这 6 张清单在 epic #26676 下立卡，裁决原话引在卡上。」 and 「还有刚才立的卡可以交给ui车道处理吗？」 (2026-11-02). So this card goes to the `domain:ui` lane queue. Priority and `area:*` are left to triage. Code readings below are on `main` `3b920f6dd0`.

## Ruling

The maintainer, on how to tighten the derived strip: 「A1「派生条带」该怎么收紧：没声明就不挑」 (2026-11-02). The seat offered two routes:

- (a) an object that declares no `highlightFields` gets no strip;
- (b) keep deriving, but never empty the body and never take the owner.

The maintainer chose (a).

## Observed

1. **Empty overview.** Account Acme Corp has four business fields: industry, annual revenue, website and owner. All four are put into the strip and hidden from the body. The left column then holds only the meta line 「创建于 … · 负责人 · id」.
2. **Stage twice.** On an opportunity, the stage is drawn by the path bar and again as the body field 阶段. Since #28061 the path itself changes the stage.
3. **Owner twice, under two words.** On contact Ada, the strip says 「所有者」 and the meta line says 「负责人」. Every derived page shows the owner in both places.

## Reading

- `deriveHighlightFields` (`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts:495`):
  - It picks up to six fields from a preferred list whose first entries are `owner` / `owner_id` (line 537).
  - The default page uses it when `highlightFields` is undeclared (line 703), and passes the same list to the body as `hideFields`.
- It has two more readers, which carry the same strip:
  - the phone record header, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/recordPhoneHeader.ts:69`;
  - the record hover card's key fields, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/record-preview/RecordPreviewCard.tsx:172`.
- Stage: the path's `statusField` is not in the body's `hideFields`.
- Owner:
  - the meta line is `RecordMetaFooter.tsx:290`, `t('detail.owner')`, which is 「负责人」 in `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/zh.ts:1297`;
  - the platform label of the system field `owner_id` is 「所有者」 in `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts:3998`.

## Governing text

#27524 item 12: "Highlights are the object's declared `highlightFields` minus the name field (the title), max 6 … nothing invents one." Derivation goes beyond that item, so this card brings the code back to it.

## Target

1. **No derived strip.** An object with no declared `highlightFields` has no strip, so every field stays in the body. This applies to all three readers:
   - the default page;
   - the phone header;
   - the hover card.

   `deriveHighlightFields`'s preferred-name guessing is deleted, not kept behind a flag. A declared strip is unchanged: the declared list minus the name field, max 6.
2. **Stage once.** When the page draws `record:path`, its `statusField` joins the body's `hideFields`.
3. **Owner once.** When the strip carries the owner field, the meta line leaves the owner out. Otherwise the meta line keeps it.
4. **One word for the owner,** used by both the ui key `detail.owner` and the spec system label of `owner_id`, across the ten packs.
   - The seat recommends 「负责人」 in zh: the person who follows the record up.
   - The word is not ruled by the maintainer. The claiming seat states its choice in the PR.
5. No new metadata key and no new gate.

Consequence: `examples/app-crm` declares no `highlightFields`, so its pages lose the strip. #28870 (app-crm hygiene, filed in the same batch) declares them. HotCRM declares them already.

## Acceptance

- An object without `highlightFields` shows no strip on the page, in the phone header or in the hover card, and the body shows every field.
- An object with `highlightFields` shows exactly the declared list minus the name field.
- An opportunity with a path has no 阶段 field in the body.
- The owner appears once on the page, under one word in zh and en.
- The tests pin each of the four rules.
